share.local: Recipes with no service of their own, so there is nothing to serve: a linked office reads the same recipes from its own copy of the source.

summary.he: כל הפעולות שהלשכה יודעת לעשות, כמתכון טקסט קצר אחד לכל פעולה — איפה היא רצה, ואיזו מהן בקשה צריכה
summary.en: Every action the office can do, as one short plain-text recipe each: where it runs, and the one a request needs
